# Test Suite SQL Eval (vendored subset)

This directory contains the unmodified `exec_eval.py` and `parse.py` files from
[`taoyds/test-suite-sql-eval`](https://github.com/taoyds/test-suite-sql-eval)
at commit `e97acc546ecbee8fa27fa8dbf025ef61493a876c`.

The upstream project is licensed under Apache-2.0; its license is preserved in
`LICENSE`. SqurveBridge verifies both source checksums before loading the
adapter. The evaluator stays default-off and also requires checksummed suite
database resources.
